_comment: RV-20: a recorded-shape OpenAI chat-completions reply from LiteLLM (alias local-heavy) to the qwen-rate prompt for one show and two personas (comfort-companion, mechanism-hunter), as the tests in qwen-rate.test.mjs build it. Synthetic, written by hand to the shape LiteLLM returns; no model was called. It satisfies the strictest tier (show-metadata: audio sub-scores and host_count null, confidence <= 0.5), so it is a valid answer for a show at any tier. Its evidence_tier and flags are deliberately the plain ones: the script replaces the tier with the pack's and ORs the pack's explicit and injection pre-scan into the flags.
